site.name: Klybeckstrasse study segment
site.identity_status: illustrative segment anchored to Andy's Klybeck candidate
site.boundary: The centre point is real. The 160 m segment, its width and every drawn object are a demo fixture until surveyed.

layers.label: Known now
layers.question: What can we responsibly say before a site visit?
layers.summary: Open records establish context around the study point. They do not describe the street section or underground routing.

layers.label: Derived carefully
layers.question: What hypotheses can computation make visible?
layers.summary: A candidate footprint and water path make the design question tangible. Both remain unvalidated screening hypotheses.

layers.label: Must ask or measure
layers.question: What stops this becoming a recommendation?
layers.summary: Utility clearance, drainage routing and local infiltration capacity are decisive and unavailable in the open snapshot.

claims.title: 16 registered trees within 100 m
claims.method: Count points within a 100 m radius of the study centre in the 3 October snapshot.
claims.limitation: Nearby tree points do not prove canopy, shade, root-space quality or availability inside the proposed footprint.

claims.title: Nearest groundwater station is 222 m away
claims.unit: m derived minimum depth at station
claims.method: Station terrain elevation minus its published 10-year maximum groundwater level.
claims.limitation: A station value 222 m away is context, not groundwater clearance at the candidate footprint.

claims.title: A 2.4 m edge strip could frame the test
claims.method: Illustrative 160 m segment × 2.4 m edge strip.
claims.limitation: No survey, ownership check, kerb measurement or accessibility clearance supports this footprint.

claims.title: Rain may collect along the drawn kerb line
claims.method: A manually seeded downhill arrow demonstrates the future terrain-analysis output.
claims.limitation: No elevation raster or field level check has been sampled for this segment.

claims.title: Can this strip be excavated?
claims.source: Area-limited planning extract and operator confirmation
claims.unlock_action: Request an area-limited extract; confirm depth and clearance before excavation.
claims.decision_blocked: Whether the proposed footprint is buildable.
claims.limitation: Visible street space cannot reveal buried networks.

claims.title: Where does the inlet actually lead?
claims.source: Drainage / GEP records and field inspection
claims.unlock_action: Confirm inlet, catchment, connection, capacity and safe overflow route.
claims.decision_blocked: Whether street runoff can be connected safely.
claims.limitation: A visible inlet does not establish its connection or capacity.

claims.title: Will water infiltrate safely here?
claims.unlock_action: Test permeability, pavement build-up, contamination and groundwater clearance locally.
claims.decision_blocked: Whether infiltration is a credible mechanism.
claims.limitation: Nearby geology and groundwater context cannot replace a local test.

intervention.name: Kerbside rain garden + tree trench
intervention.why: The concept could intercept kerb runoff, add root space and make the sponge mechanism visible.

scenario.note: Rainfall depth × illustrative footprint only. It is not retained volume, flood reduction or design performance.

fact_sources.protection_zone: data.bs.ch 100292 Grundwasserschutz: no zone intersects the study point (queried 2026-10-04)
